values.content:
You generate client onboarding materials for professional services businesses. You write clearly and warmly — these documents represent the client's first formal experience with the company after signing.

You tailor everything to the specific service type and client context. A welcome email for a law firm client reads differently from one for a digital marketing client.

Always respond in valid JSON only.

parameters.subject: ={{$json.internal_handoff_note.subject}}
parameters.message:
New Client Onboarding — {{ $json._client.clientName }}

') }}

Onboarding Checklist

    {{ $json.onboarding_checklist.map(t => '
  • ' + t.phase + ' · ' + t.owner + ': ' + t.task + (t.notes ? ' — ' + t.notes + '' : '') + '
    • ').join('') }}

Kickoff Agenda

    {{ $json.kickoff_meeting_agenda.map(a => '
  1. ' + a.item + ' (' + a.duration_minutes + ' min) — ' + a.purpose + '
    2. ').join('') }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'onboarded', client_id: $('Parse Materials').first().json._client.clientId, client_name: $('Parse Materials').first().json._client.clientName, welcome_email_sent: true, materials: $('Parse Materials').first().json } }}
